data.text: User specifies this GitHub repository and the existing Anthropic API credential for the proposed feedback-to-code feature. Coding-agent execution must be hosted in the cloud, not on the demo Mac. The Mac runs the local demo app and may receive approved updates; do not install/run a local coding worker or interpret this as authorization for public hosting, merges or automatic release. Proposed runner choice and implementation remain pending.
data.rationale: User clarified that the demo is local while Claude's repository-changing execution must be remote. Preserve that separation when designing the integration.
